stance: Measurement repositories are now forced to expand their registries beyond standard crawlers to account for task-executing browser automation bots.
adoption_shape: The growth of the Known Agents directory across 41 pages shows catalogers actively incorporating autonomous user agents, recognizing that interactive browsing bots represent a distinct operational profile from conventional data collection bots.
new_entrants: Anthropic arrived with Claude-Agent, seeking to operate a cloud browser agent for Claude Duet that performs multi-step tasks on behalf of users.
watch_for: Whether tracking frameworks record further additions of cloud browser agents that expand the directory beyond its current 41 pages.
